description: This PHP class, 'CalendarAccountEvent', represents a calendar event entity within the SuiteCRM project. It encapsulates event properties such as ID, name, description, location, start and end dates, and synchronization details. The class provides methods for retrieving and modifying these properties, as well as comparing event contents via checksum calculation. It is used to manage calendar event data in the context of integrating or syncing calendar information.

classes.name: CalendarAccountEvent
classes.description: A class representing a calendar event with properties for scheduling, metadata, and sync information, including methods for property access and checksum-based comparison.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the event.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name/title of the event.

methods.name: getDateStartString
methods.description: Returns the start date/time of the event as an ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: getDateStart
methods.description: Returns the start date/time as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getDateEndString
methods.description: Returns the end date/time as an ISO 8601 string if available.

methods.name: getDateEnd
methods.description: Returns the end date/time as a DateTime object if set.

methods.name: getAssignedUserId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user assigned to the event.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of calendar event (e.g., meeting).

methods.name: getLinkedEventId
methods.description: Returns the linked external event ID if any.

methods.name: setLinkedEventId
methods.description: Sets the linked external event ID.

methods.name: getLastSyncString
methods.description: Returns the last sync timestamp as an ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: getLastSync
methods.description: Returns the last synchronization DateTime.

methods.name: setLastSync
methods.description: Sets the last sync DateTime.

methods.name: getDateModifiedString
methods.description: Returns the modification timestamp as an ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: getDateModified
methods.description: Returns the modification DateTime.

methods.name: isExternal
methods.description: Indicates whether the event is external.

methods.name: getStartDateTime
methods.description: Returns the start DateTime object.

methods.name: getEndDateTime
methods.description: Returns the end DateTime object.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the event's title.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the event's description.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the event's location.

methods.name: getContentChecksum
methods.description: Returns the checksum representing the content of the event.

methods.name: getChecksumArray
methods.description: Returns an array of key properties used for checksum calculation.

methods.name: calculateChecksum
methods.description: Computes and returns an MD5 checksum based on key event properties for content comparison.
